caseName: Western Union Telegraph Co. v. Esteve Bros. & Co.
caseNameFull: Western Union Telegraph Company v. Esteve Brothers & Company

opinions.text: October 18, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals, for the Fifth Circuit granted. Mr. Rush Taggart, Mr. Francis Raymond Stark, Mr. W. B. Spencer and Mr. Joseph P. Egan for petitioner. Mr. Monte M. Lemann for respondent.
